answer.reason: The instance has three footer-related models: Footer (the container holding the footer's link lists), FooterLink (individual text+URL links shown in the footer, e.g. 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms', etc.), and FooterSocialLink (icon links to social media profiles). A privacy policy link is a standard textual link, not a social icon, so a new content item representing it should be created in the FooterLink model/container and then associated with the Footer content item.
